clue.text: Charlie wears floppy straw hat, Penny a bracelet

indicators.note: whatever wears clothing has it around it, so the next letters go round the first
something floppy has lost its shape, so these letters lose their order too

blocks.note: Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet
taken as written
p is the abbreviation for a penny

explanation.surface: Someone called Charlie dons a battered straw hat, and a girl called Penny wears a bracelet.
explanation.walkthrough: C goes inside the hat letters, the whole lot is shuffled, and P is added at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A watch strap goes round the wrist, so it is a band worn like a bracelet.

clue.text: Miss an important part of school?
